statement.text:
Does there exist a constant c such that the number of conjugacy classes in a
finite group G is always at least c log2 |G|?
    Editors’ comment of 2021: It is proved that every group G contains at least
ε log |G|/(log log |G|)8 conjugacy classes for some fixed ε > 0 (L. Pyber, J. London
Math. Soc. (2), 46, no. 2 (1992), 239–249). It is also proved that for every ε > 0
there exists δ > 0 such that every finite group G of order at least 3 has at least
δ log2 |G|/(log2 log2 |G|)3+ε conjugacy classes (B. Baumeister, A. Maróti, H. P. Tong-
Viet, Forum Math., 29, no. 2 (2017), 259–275).                              E. Bertram
